name: ds-web
description: Live web search and page fetch for DeepSeek models on Codex, backed by DeepSeek's own Search/Fetch API.

interface.shortDescription: Give DeepSeek models real web search and page fetching
interface.longDescription: Bundles two MCP tools (web_search, web_fetch) that call DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch APIs. A PreToolUse hook denies these tools to non-DeepSeek models, and a profile-scoped switch keeps the server unloaded in GPT sessions.
defaultPrompt: Search the web for the latest DeepSeek V4 release notes
Fetch this URL and summarize it
